field.name: operationKey
field.description: The key of the authorize#, capture#, release# or refund#SinglePayment call that got this response; a retry with the key answers this response.

field.name: refundPaymentId
field.description: The refund Payment a refund response created or completed.

field.name: idempotencyKey
field.description: The key Mantle gave the gateway for this operation (make#GatewayIdempotencyKey: the operation key bound to the payment, gateway, operation and amount), which the adapter sends as the provider's idempotency key or a searchable reference and records here. A details lookup after a lost answer looks the operation up by it.

field.name: resultUnknown
field.description: Y: the adapter cannot tell whether the provider did the operation (the answer was lost after the request may have been sent). Neither approved nor declined; the payment's next gateway mutation is refused until a details lookup resolves it (outcomeResolvedDate).

field.name: outcomeResolvedDate
field.description: When a details lookup (get#SinglePaymentGatewayDetails) told the outcome of an unknown response.

field.name: outcomeFound
field.description: The resolved outcome of an unknown response: Y the provider did the operation, N it has none (a retry with the operation key sends it again, with the same idempotency key).

field.name: gatewayCustomerId
field.description: The provider's customer (profile) reference that gatewayCimId, the reusable payment profile, belongs to at the gateway in paymentGatewayConfigId. Kept on the method, not the Party, so two gateways' profiles of one party do not collide; a new method of the same party and gateway reuses it.

entity.description: The non-secret options of an Authorize.Net gateway (PaymentGatewayConfig with paymentGatewayTypeEnumId PgtAuthorizeNet, shared key). The connection is the config's SystemMessageRemote: sendUrl the API endpoint (https://apitest.authorize.net/xml/v1/request.api for the sandbox, https://api.authorize.net/xml/v1/request.api for production), usageCode T or P, username the API login id, password the transaction key, sharedSecret the webhook signature key (messageAuthEnumId SmatHmacSha512, authHeaderName X-ANET-Signature). Ported from the AuthorizeDotNet component's PaymentGatewayAuthorizeNet, whose login and transaction key move to the remote's encrypted fields.

field.name: publicClientKey
field.description: The public client key for Accept.js (Account, Settings, Manage Public Client Key). Public: the browser gets it with the API login id.

field.name: validationMode
field.description: For a new customer payment profile: none (the default), testMode or liveMode (a zero or small authorization that validates the card).

field.name: duplicateWindow
field.description: Seconds for the provider's duplicate transaction check (transactionSettings duplicateWindow); empty for the provider's default. Not Mantle's idempotency: a retry after a lost answer is looked up by its reference first.

field.name: lookupGraceSeconds
field.description: How old a lost answer must be before a lookup that finds no transaction for its reference answers that the provider has none (not done); a younger one stays unknown, as the provider may still be processing it. Empty is 300; it is always at least duplicateWindow plus 60, as a resend inside the duplicate window would be refused.

entity.description: The non-secret options of a PayTrace gateway (PaymentGatewayConfig with paymentGatewayTypeEnumId PgtPayTrace, shared key), on the PayTrace JSON API v3. The connection is the config's SystemMessageRemote: sendUrl the API base (https://api.sandbox.paytrace.com for the sandbox, https://api.paytrace.com for production), usageCode T or P (it picks the Protect.js host), username the API user (OAuth client_id) and password its password (client_secret), in the remote's encrypted fields. Ported from the mantle-paytrace component's PaymentGatewayPayTrace, whose login moves to the remote and whose hostName and apiVersion are replaced by the remote's endpoint and the v3 paths.

field.name: merchantId
field.description: The PayTrace merchant account id (merchant_id, a number) every transaction request names.

field.name: integratorId
field.description: The integrator id PayTrace issued for this integration (X-Integrator-Id, up to 12 characters), sent with every request. It identifies the integration, not the account, and is not a credential.

field.name: currencyUomId
field.description: The currency of the merchant account. PayTrace amounts carry no currency, so a payment in another currency is refused (CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED) rather than sent.

field.name: lookupGraceSeconds
field.description: How old a lost answer must be before a lookup that finds no transaction for its reference answers that the provider has none (not done); a younger one stays unknown, as PayTrace's export may lag. Empty is 300.

field.name: sendEnhancedData
field.description: N to send no level 2/3 enhanced data; empty or Y sends it after each capture or sale of a payment with an order or invoice.

field.name: commodityCode
field.description: The level 3 commodity code of a line whose product has none (ProductIdentification PidtCommodityCode): the code the merchant service provider assigned, 3 to 20 letters, digits or dashes.

field.name: defaultUnitOfMeasure
field.description: The level 3 unit of measure of a line with no quantity unit, or one with no PayTrace code (1 to 12 letters or digits, such as PCE or EA).

field.name: customerLabelPrefix
field.description: Put before the vault customer label ("mantle-" and the payment method id), for instances sharing one PayTrace account (their method ids can repeat).

view-entity.description: Gateway responses with the parties of their payment, for organization and privacy conditions.
